shadows.name: mega-menu
shadows.purpose: Full-width desktop navigation disclosure; removed in mobile disclosures.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: 8px upward fade; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;border-radius:4px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--foreground);font:600 1rem var(--font-sans,"Plus Jakarta Sans",sans-serif);padding:12px 24px;border:1px solid var(--border-soft);cursor:pointer;transition:transform 100ms ease-out,opacity 150ms ease-out;}.ds-button-secondary:active{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0f382a);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-secondary{transition:none}}

components.name: Search Field
components.css: .ds-search{font:400 .8rem var(--font-sans,"Plus Jakarta Sans",sans-serif);color:var(--foreground)}.ds-search input{display:block;min-height:46px;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--foreground);border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:4px;font:inherit}.ds-search input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0f382a);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Direct destination label in MegaNavigation; adjacent accessible toggle opens a full-width grouped disclosure above 1100px, or an inline mobile disclosure at narrower widths.
components.html: Star Notes Lookup

components.name: Card
components.description: Shared bordered surface with optional existing hover treatment.
components.css: .ds-card{padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:6px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--foreground);transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.ds-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 20px -12px rgb(15 56 42 / 20%)}.ds-card h3{font:600 1.25rem/1.3 var(--font-display,"Playfair Display",serif)}.ds-card a{color:var(--accent);font-family:var(--font-sans,"Plus Jakarta Sans",sans-serif)}.ds-card a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-card a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0f382a);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-card{transition:none}}

components.name: Editorial Tool Callout
components.description: Category-aware tool link beside the journal feed.
components.html:
Fancy Serial Number Checker

Check your banknote with the tools behind these guides.

Open tool ?
components.css: .ds-tool{background:#0f382a;color:#fbf9f4;padding:30px 24px;border-radius:5px}.ds-tool h2{font:600 1.75rem/1.2 var(--font-display,"Playfair Display",serif)}.ds-tool p{font:.87rem/1.8 var(--font-sans,"Plus Jakarta Sans",sans-serif);margin:20px 0 24px;color:#d5e5d9}.ds-tool a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;background:#e6bd4a;color:#172b23;padding:14px 18px;border-radius:3px;font:700 .8rem var(--font-sans,"Plus Jakarta Sans",sans-serif);min-height:48px;text-decoration:none}.ds-tool a:hover{background:#f4ce61}.ds-tool a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
The supplied Stitch references establish a collector's reference desk: parchment surfaces, forest ink, engraved serif headings, and restrained metallic accents. Tools and factual guides share a calm editorial hierarchy with illustrative editorial photographs, crisp banknote diagrams, and readable serial data.

This records the implemented styles in `src/app/globals.css`, font loading in `src/app/layout.tsx`, and shared components. `PRODUCT.md` governs content preservation; the references supply visual direction rather than replacement copy.
keyCharacteristics: Serif headings, sans-serif reading, monospaced serials.
Fine borders, compact corners, restrained elevation.
Editorial photographs alongside preserved inline banknote diagrams.

rules.name: The Three Roles Rule
rules.body: Keep headings, reading text, and serial data in their established font roles.

dos: Do use semantic color variables for theme-aware surfaces and text.
Do preserve the original note diagrams and accessible descriptions.
Do retain existing factual copy, headings, URLs, and metadata during visual work.
Do keep visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't substitute reference-design copy for the site's collector content.
Don't add account, newsletter, auction, or registry interfaces from reference imagery.
Don't treat legacy font comments as the active font specification.
